description: This file defines a controller class 'ManageController' responsible for handling user account management operations in an ASP.NET Core web application. It includes actions for profile management, password management, two-factor authentication, external login linking, and recovery codes.

classes.name: ManageController
classes.description: Controller class for managing user account activities including profile updates, password changes, two-factor authentication setup, and external login management.

methods.name: MyAccount
methods.description: GET action that retrieves and displays the current user's account details.

methods.name: MyAccount (POST)
methods.description: Updates user profile details such as email and phone number.

methods.name: SendVerificationEmail
methods.description: Sends a new email verification for the user.

methods.name: ChangePassword
methods.description: GET action that displays the change password view.

methods.name: ChangePassword (POST)
methods.description: Processes password change requests.

methods.name: SetPassword
methods.description: GET action for setting a new password if none exists.

methods.name: SetPassword (POST)
methods.description: Handles setting a new password.

methods.name: ExternalLogins
methods.description: Displays linked external login providers and options.

methods.name: LinkLogin
methods.description: Initiates linking an external login provider.

methods.name: LinkLoginCallback
methods.description: Completes linking external login after callback.

methods.name: RemoveLogin
methods.description: Removes an external login from the user account.

methods.name: TwoFactorAuthentication
methods.description: Displays two-factor authentication status and options.

methods.name: Disable2faWarning
methods.description: Shows warning before disabling 2FA.

methods.name: Disable2fa
methods.description: Disables two-factor authentication.

methods.name: EnableAuthenticator
methods.description: Starts process to enable authenticator app 2FA.

methods.name: ShowRecoveryCodes
methods.description: Displays recovery codes for 2FA.

methods.name: ResetAuthenticatorWarning
methods.description: Shows warning before resetting authenticator app key.

methods.name: ResetAuthenticator
methods.description: Resets 2FA authenticator app key.

methods.name: GenerateRecoveryCodes
methods.description: Generates new 2FA recovery codes.

methods.name: GenerateRecoveryCodesWarning
methods.description: Shows warning before generating new recovery codes.
